facts.text: Penny, my hat just served up a hot dog and I am not sure how. Grab a plate before it fires off another one.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Gadget's words, but it is not in the film. The only hot dog gag on the quote page is the Gadgetmobile swerving round a hot dog vendor. No hat serves a hot dog.
facts.fix: Penny, plates are out. Stand clear of my arms, I still don't know which gadget does what.

vibe.verdict: Bright gear-and-chalkboard look that suits the film, but the words stay generic and skip the movie's best gags.
